runtime.llvm_abi: Exported LLVM C entry points checked against the iOS SDK libLLVM.tbd
runtime.privilege: Existing administrator-only IOGPU device connection; trusted shader ISA registration
runtime.cache: Per-device bounded weak in-memory library cache; no disk cache or executable CPU pages

control_flow.air_lowering: Postdominator joins for acyclic graphs; per-invocation dispatch for loops or large crossing graphs. PHIs are parallel copies on the selected edge. No artificial iteration truncation.
control_flow.resource_address_proof: Bounded scalar/vector SSBO accesses; pointer/address PHIs remain unsupported

llvm_c_compatibility.switch_cases: Legacy operand-pair representation or a dynamically resolved public LLVMGetSwitchCaseValue accessor; no private LLVM object layouts

compute.workgroup_size: runtime variable; uniform groups or exact partial edge groups
compute.resource_address_proof: NIR guards on final SSBO byte offsets; typed indices and relative address arithmetic preserve overflow information
references: Mesa src/gallium/drivers/freedreno/a5xx/fd5_compute.c and src/freedreno/ir3/ir3_shader.h at the pinned compiler commit

buffer_access.address_model: 64-bit relative GEP arithmetic represented as two uint32 words; aligned word access only; physical base remains an opaque binding
buffer_access.load_policy: per-component zero outside the actual binding byte range
buffer_access.descriptor_size_source: A5xx SSBO resinfo returns byte count as low/high 16 bits
msl_constants: readonly struct fields with Metal float3 padding
references: Pinned Mesa src/freedreno/ir3/ir3_compiler_nir.c emit_intrinsic_ssbo_size and src/compiler/nir/ API
Pinned Mesa src/gallium/drivers/freedreno/freedreno_screen.c PIPE_SHADER_CAP_MAX_SHADER_BUFFERS and a5xx/fd5_emit.c emit_ssbos; ir3/ir3_image.c ir3_ssbo_to_ibo

msl_storage: threadgroup scalar/vector/atomic pointer or reference arguments [[threadgroup(0..7)]]
threadgroup_memory.air_storage: Uninitialized addrspace(3) globals and air.buffer addrspace(3) arguments; 32-bit scalar/vector/relaxed integer atomic accesses
threadgroup_memory.native_metadata: sharedBytes aligned static prefix, threadgroupMask dynamic arguments; shader/JIT 15/13; Dispatch 648, Draw 1016, description/image 1732/7992 bytes
threadgroup_memory.backend: Mesa IR3 LDL/STL, FENCE and BAR; fd5_compute.c fixed HLSQ_CS_CNTL_1=1
threadgroup_memory.address_bounds: Invalid or huge relative offsets are clamped to the 32 KiB capacity before NIR adds a variable base; final per-component NIR bounds cover the allocated shared region and intrinsic-base overflow.
threadgroup_memory.dynamic_layout: Static objects precede a 16-byte-aligned raw shared pool; native admission packs positive aligned lengths within the combined 32768-byte capacity. The first 16 IR3 constant words hold relative byte offsets and lengths.
threadgroup_memory.dynamic_bounds: Per-argument 64-bit offset/alignment/component checks precede each shared access; invalid loads/atomics return zero and invalid stores/atomics do not execute. Final shared NIR guards also enforce the 32768-byte allocation.
threadgroup_memory.compiler_integration: Defer GL shared-variable layout only for the generated dynamic pool; Interface.h assigns its base, trims the reservation, and lowers explicit shared IO. IR3 reserves four vec4 user constants before driver params/immediates.

memory: compute static and dynamic threadgroup memory
integer_atomics.load_lowering: atomicOr(0), conservatively treated as a write
integer_atomics.signed_minmax_lowering: CAS retry over the raw uint view
integer_atomics.weak_cas: strong CAS is used; no spurious failure
integer_atomics.cas_expected: matching thread-local int32 scalar; updated on comparison failure
air_forms: LLVM int32 atomicrmw/cmpxchg and relaxed atomic load/store
integer_atomics.bounds: Per-word NIR guard branches around the atomic; out-of-range/unaligned operations execute no atomic and return zero
references: Pinned Mesa ir3/ir3_a4xx.c emit_atomic/emit_intrinsic_atomic_ssbo and ir3_compiler_nir.c emit_intrinsic_atomic_shared

texture_mipmaps.linear_layout: RGBA8 fdl5, pitchalign=8 (256 bytes), fdl_pitch minifies aligned base pitch with a minimum of one before alignment; last level has 32-row padding; complete layer is page aligned
texture_mipmaps.single_level_compatibility: existing 64-byte row alignment and exact image span; IOSurface remains single-level
compiler_sample_lod: AIR sample mode with float32 level or bias
texture_mipmaps.generation: mipmap_rgba8 AOT compute kernel, per-level nonoverlapping source texture0 and destination image7; sampler0 linear filtering in linear RGB; sRGB encoded by bounded image stores; serial native fences; no CPU generation
texture_mipmaps.native_range: full chain length checked against resource and alias spans; attachments/CPU/blit use selected single-level planes
texture_mipmaps.sampler_lod: unsigned 8.8 min/max, mip none/nearest/linear; fd5 none clamps to 0.125
references: Metal SDK MTLBlitCommandEncoder whole-mip copy and generateMipmaps contracts
Metal SDK MTLRenderCommandEncoder sampler LOD clamps

compute_textures.mip_access: uint32 dynamic or constant mip level; per-level dimensions and range checks
compute_textures.backend: A540 guarded SSBO 8..15 for linear image read/write; hardware CS texture state block 5 and independent sampler indices for normalized sample/level, no CPU pixel execution
compute_textures.barrier: mem_texture uses buffer memory barrier plus workgroup execution barrier
references: Pinned Mesa fd5_image.c SSBO image-store model, fd5_emit.c SSBO bank capacity
Pinned Mesa fdl5_layout/fdl_pitch linear mip layout

sampler_state.mirror_clamp: Production GLSL abs/gradient reflection with native-owned flags for POT/NPOT. Fragment implicit/bias sampling preserves derivatives of the original coordinates before mirror reflection.
sampler_state.anisotropy_encoding: Mesa fd5 floor-power-of-two cap; ANISO filter only when linear filtering is selected
sampler_state.pixel_coordinates_restrictions: edge modes, no mip filter, anisotropy one
sampler_state.border_table: Three immutable A5xx 128-byte entries in private read-only IB, 512-byte aligned
sampler_state.unsupported: Mixed S/T ClampToZero and nontransparent ClampToBorderColor in one sampler; depth comparison and arbitrary custom colors
sampler_state.explicit_lod: Dedicated unclamped hardware sampler slots: CS logical+8, FS 1, shared texture index; implicit/bias/gradient retain clamps
sampler_state.gradient: MSL gradient2d for compute/vertex/fragment AOT/JIT, real IR3 derivative sampling; AIR gradient ABI not inferred
sampler_state.constants: Compute sampler flags at words 48..55 in reserved 64-word prefix; Fragment flags at word 0 in reserved 16-word prefix; image-only 48 and dynamic-shared-only 16 remain
sampler_state.wire: shader/JIT 27/24; Texture44, Sampler28, Dispatch792, Draw2704, description2384/image20936
references: Apple MSL specification texture LOD semantics
sampler_state.derivative_lowering: Standalone GL NIR options set scalarize_ddx=true, matching pinned IR3 compiler requirements before vector ddx/ddy are created.

srgb_color_formats.storage: existing four-byte linear fdl5 layout and task-authorized IOSurface imports
srgb_color_formats.sampling: A5xx TEX_CONST_0_SRGB, RGB decoding before filtering
srgb_color_formats.render: RB_MRT_BUF_INFO_COLOR_SRGB and SP_FS_MRT_REG_COLOR_SRGB; fixed-function linear blending
srgb_color_formats.image_read_write: shared MSL/AIR AOT/JIT GLSL helpers decode/encode RGB around bounded SSBO loads/stores; alpha remains linear
srgb_color_formats.mipmap: native per-level dispatch, source plane sampler0/texture0, destination image7; nonoverlapping physical subranges; hardware bilinear linear-space filtering; sRGB encode before guarded stores
srgb_color_formats.cpu_blit: raw encoded bytes; user-mode clear encodes linear RGB once

texture_views.type: 2D and color 2DArray, nonempty parent-relative mip/slice ranges; nested views flatten offsets and retain the original layer stride and parent
texture_views.storage: no new GPU resource/allocation; textureSize checks addressable pitch*height mip span, allocation still uses the complete padded fdl5 layout
texture_views.compiler: unchanged MSL/AIR AOT/JIT geometry and mip functions operate relative to the rebased view
texture_views.native: original task/resource/session, geometry, CPU/GPU synchronization and physical alias checks are preserved; compatible IOSurface color views retain single-level geometry
texture_views.render_blit_clear: view-selected plane offsets, format and dimensions; copies compare actual backing byte ranges rather than relative mip indices
texture_views.sampling: A5xx rebased pointer/pitch, visible MIPLVLS, original layer stride and visible layer count with matching RGBA/BGRA/sRGB/swizzle state
references: Pinned Mesa fdl5_layout: final 32-row allocation padding is required by GMEM blits; this backend exposes only direct 2D sampling/rendering and bounded linear buffer copies

texture_swizzle.encoding: Zero is identity; otherwise four semantic 3-bit channel selectors plus one. All-zero swizzle has encoding1. Invalid selectors/high bits are rejected.
texture_swizzle.composition: view selectors index the effective parent pattern; constants are propagated; a view without an explicit swizzle inherits the parent pattern.
texture_swizzle.native_sampling: A5xx SWIZ_X/Y/Z/W composed with storage-format RGBA/BGRA order; sRGB conversion precedes read swizzle.
texture_swizzle.compute_reads: Shared MSL/AIR AOT/JIT read helper decodes sRGB, fixes BGRA order, then applies native-owned swizzle bits in image geometry word.w[16..27].
texture_swizzle.mip_count: Image geometry word.w[8..15] is masked independently from swizzle; get_num_mip_levels and coordinate/mip bounds keep the visible view count.
texture_swizzle.writes: Compute stores, render attachments, clears and byte copies ignore read swizzle. Internal blit mip generation clears swizzle in source/destination descriptors so successive levels filter stored color without accumulating channel permutations.
texture_swizzle.oob: Existing bounded RGBA/BGRA reads return all-zero for invalid coordinates/mip before swizzle; stores remain suppressed.
texture_swizzle.depth_stencil: Identity only for D32 shader reads/sampling and render/resolve/blit depth/stencil planes.
primary_references: Pinned Mesa fd5_format.c fd5_tex_swiz and a5xx.xml a5xx_tex_swiz

nonuniform_compute.implementation: Cartesian full/tail regions, at most eight CP_EXEC_CS launches with actual local sizes inside one original native submission and completion fence
nonuniform_compute.driver_constants: Actual physical region local/groups, zero hardware base group; native read-only word64..79 contains global thread/group bases, original grid/group counts and requested local XYZ in words67/71/75.
nonuniform_compute.resource_state: Code, textures/samplers/SSBO descriptors are uploaded once; constants and NDRANGE are updated per region; real threads only, group-local shared allocation and barriers preserved.
nonuniform_compute.limits: Original active grid <=16777216 invocations, requested local product <=1024, group XYZ<=65535 and requested Z<=64; actual groups=ceil(grid/local). Fixed-size trusted kernels reject partial groups.
references: Pinned Mesa fd5_compute.c and A5xx NDRANGE/CP_EXEC_CS state

texture_arrays.layout: Layer-major fdl5 mip chains. Each array layer stride is page-aligned; views retain the owner stride and native bounds cover the actual last-layer/mip access span.
texture_arrays.views: Nested nonempty mip and slice ranges; 2D<->2DArray views, one slice for 2D; direct parent and backing retained.
texture_arrays.cpu_blit: Per-slice CPU reads/writes and buffer/texture copies; all source/destination intervals checked before range copies. Per-slice mip generation uses the existing hardware sampler/guarded store and native completion fences.
texture_arrays.render: One selected color slice/mip per attachment, same existing sysmem render backend; no vertex-selected layered rendering.
texture_arrays.compiler: MSL and observed float32 AIR read/write/query/sample/gradient signatures share native typed2DArray resources, guarded image SSBOs and hardware sample/fetch descriptors. AIR nonzero offsets/min-LOD and wider texel types remain rejected; target execution is unverified.
texture_arrays.native: Per-binding array type in flags bits8..15; shader/resource dimensionality must match. Compute word80..95 stores eight layer-count/byte-stride pairs before driver/immediates. FS uses native DEPTH and ARRAY_PITCH with its existing 16-word sampler prefix.
texture_arrays.image_bounds: Array slice and coordinate/mip bounds checked before address multiplication. Invalid bounded reads return zero and writes are suppressed. Swizzle and sRGB preserve existing semantics.
texture_arrays.iosurface: Creation/import stays single 2D layer; compatible 2DArray-one-layer views may share the existing authorized backing; multi-layer imported descriptors are rejected.
references: Mesa 24.3.4 pinned fd5_texture.c/fdl5_layout and IR3 array sampler lowering

msl_sampling: implicit level zero with ordinary sampler clamps
explicit float level ignoring sampler clamps
air_sampling: implicit level zero with zero bias
explicit float level using existing verified 2D intrinsic signature
vertex_texture_sampling.native_state: SB4_VS_TEX block0 and TPL1_VS_TEX_COUNT, independent from fragment block4/count. Existing texture layout, view layer stride/count, sRGB/swizzle, border color and sampler shadow state are reused.
vertex_texture_sampling.constants: Vertex and fragment sampler helpers each reserve16 words in their own stage. Mirror flags are at stage word0; driver/immediates follow the prefix. Vertex-only GLSL uniform names prevent link-time aliasing with fragment controls.
vertex_texture_sampling.resource_lifetime: Per-draw descriptor and sampler snapshots retain vertex texture/view/sampler and backing until the original native real-completion fence.
vertex_texture_sampling.alias_policy: Vertex/fragment read-only textures may alias each other or read-only buffers. Attachments and fragment buffer writes are checked against both texture stages using existing strided pinned physical-page ranges.
references: Pinned Mesa24.3.4 fd5_emit.c/IR3 and SB4_VS_TEX in adreno_pm4.xml

graphics_texture_bindings.native_state: VS block0 and FS block4 upload each active texture/sampler at its logical slot; texture count is highest active texture slot plus one. Both counts reset every draw.
graphics_texture_bindings.resource_lifetime: Separate masks admit and retain only active texture and sampler slots to real completion; unreferenced wire slots must be empty. Original task authorization, resource quota and strided physical overlap checks remain.

cube_textures.layout: Each face contains an fdl5 mip chain with page-aligned original face stride. Array length counts cubes; physical slice count is six times cube count.
cube_textures.views: Full cube groups, nested mip/cube subranges, single-face2D and face-range2DArray views retain parent/backing/original stride. Cube view slice count is six, or a multiple of six for CubeArray; first slice is preserved independently.
cube_textures.cpu_blit_render_mipmap: Existing slice operations use physical face count; selected face render/clear and per-face mip generation use2D planes.
cube_textures.native_type: Texture.cube Boolean; layers counts cubes for CubeArray and zero denotes one Cube. Flags16..23 mark cube texture slots; existing8..15 marks array types.
cube_textures.native_sampler: cubeSamplerMask identifies actual sampler bindings, enforces normalized coordinates and enables A5xx seamless filtering only for cube samplers. Cube direction coordinates do not use2D mirror abs lowering.
cube_textures.native_descriptor: A5xx TYPE2, original face ARRAY_PITCH, DEPTH number of cubes. Sampler and texture bindings remain independent.

cube_images.index_order: 2D coordinate, face, optional cube element, optional mip level. Writes prepend float4 color.
cube_images.native_constants: Existing image words16..47 describe dimensions/pitch/format/mips/swizzle; words80..95 contain actual physical face count and original face byte stride.
cube_images.type_metadata: Shape-specific native-owned uniform names derive cube/array image masks without requiring a sampler. cubeSamplerMask reflects sampled cube textures only.
cube_images.face_address: (cube*6+face)*originalFaceStride + existing2D mip/row offset; validate face<6 and cube<faceCount/6 before multiplication.
cube_images.color_helpers: Reuse production planar sRGB/BGRA/swizzle helpers in shape-specific namespaces; stores ignore view swizzle.

scope: Partial native IOGPU/Metal A540 driver with bounded MSL/AIR JIT,2D/2DArray/Cube/CubeArray color resources, native render/compute, graphics direct fetch/queries and observed float32 AIR texture read/write/query/sample/gradient signatures. Argument buffers, wider formats/language/types, nonzero AIR offsets/min-LOD, persistent task VA, generic queues/events, CAMetalLayer/display and full power/fault/runtime behavior remain incomplete. No target execution; complete families remain disabled.

shader_code_fetch.compute: Above32 units, disable BUFFER and both cached-length registers and skip CP shader preload; retain SP object address for memory fetch.
shader_code_fetch.graphics: When VS+FS exceed64 units, follow fd5_program.c FS-first cache partition; one or both stages fetch from memory.
shader_code_fetch.lifetime: All code bytes remain in the read-only private job IB and address space through real completion or quarantine.

graphics_texture_fetch.descriptor_count: highest active sampled or fetch-alias descriptor + 1; zero for query-only programs
graphics_texture_fetch.samplers: Only sample operations require sampler state. Integer fetches use ISAML without a public sampler.
graphics_texture_fetch.cube_alias: 2D array of physical faces, with original face stride, mip range, format and swizzle; validate face and cube separately before flattening.
graphics_texture_fetch.native_constants: 48-word prefix: sampler controls in words0..15, native width/height/logical array or cube count/format+mips+swizzle in words16..47.
graphics_texture_fetch.query_only: Resource validated and retained through native fence completion; no texture descriptor or pixel feedback hazard. Actual sample/fetch accesses retain attachment and write-alias rejection.
graphics_texture_fetch.oob_read: zero for invalid coordinates, face, element or mip

read_forms: legacy without sampler or planar offset
current with get_read_sampler and zero planar offset
air_texture_operations.coordinates: 32-bit integer coord/face/element/mip; float32 sample directions and gradients
air_texture_operations.texel: float4, direct or {float4,i8} with unavailable residency byte
air_texture_operations.binding_checks: Intrinsic shape and access immediate must match native semantic texture metadata; current reads require a distinct builtin read-sampler value, never a public Metal sampler.
air_texture_operations.underlying_read_backend: Compute guarded image SSBOs; graphics integer-fetch descriptor aliases8..15; native IOGPU resources and fence lifetime unchanged.
air_texture_operations.primary_reference_toolchain: Public modern Apple metal32023.883/32023.921 outputs; acceptance of observed forms is not an iOS18 ABI or runtime guarantee. Existing older2D AIR forms retained.
air_texture_operations.texture_result_ssa: Materialize float4 texels at the original AIR read/sample call, including aggregate results; later extraction or branches do not reissue a resource read across writes or move implicit derivatives.
air_texture_operations.runtime_32bit_conversions: Typed air.convert between float32 and signed/unsigned int32 scalars or vectors1..4, validated name/type agreement; no guessed rounding/saturation modifiers.
unsupported: dynamic sample offsets or nonzero read-planar offsets
air_texture_operations.nonzero_offset_scope: constant -8..7 sample/gradient texel offsets for 2D and 2DArray; dynamic sample and nonzero read-planar offsets remain unsupported

source: MSL constant/constexpr sampler constructors with lexical scope
AIR read-only addrspace(2) i64 or [2 x i64] globals, including constant bitcasts
constant_samplers.allocation: Reserve only used external implicit/gradient i and explicit-LOD i+8 states, then assign literals to the remaining physical slots. Reject any overlap or exhaustion. Implicit and explicit states are separately allocated.
constant_samplers.state: Semantic filters, fixed 8.8 LOD clamps, address modes, anisotropy, border color and coordinates in the immutable program prefix; native A5xx state emitted per dispatch/draw. Public Sampler remains 28 bytes.
unsupported: fractional LOD clamps not representable in 8.8
pixel-coordinate modes outside the current native profile
constant_samplers.internal_glsl_linker: 32 active combined uniforms per VS/FS/CS; virtual binding192 and post-link sampler indices256..511 do not widen public or hardware slots.
constant_samplers.msl_default_address: clamp_to_edge, verified against Apple table2.7; mirror_clamp_to_edge is not an MSL constexpr enum

multiple_color_attachments.msl: Fragment float4 color(n) struct members, sparse slots and independently evaluated outputs
multiple_color_attachments.air: Float4 render_target metadata for up to eight aggregate members with unique indices0..7; dual-source blending index zero only
multiple_color_attachments.native: Immutable compiler output mask and real IR3 register per color; A5xx SP_FS_OUTPUT_REG0..7, highest framebuffer slot plus one in MRT count, per-target address/format/mask/blend state
multiple_color_attachments.lifetime: All color/depth/stencil attachments are checked and retained; physical alias checks cover all attachments, sampled/fetched pixels and stage buffers
multiple_color_attachments.scope: Linear RGBA8/BGRA8 UNorm/sRGB, 1x/2x/4x attachments and explicit array slices. No layered rendering or dual-source blending.
multiple_color_attachments.raster_order_groups: Explicitly rejected until fragment interlock is implemented
multiple_color_attachments.aot_jit_interface_assignment: Shared qgpu_assign_graphics_io orders semantic IO locations before IR3; arbitrary AIR aggregate member order does not change compiler entry point behavior.

depth_outputs: MSL scalar float struct member depth(any/less/greater)
AIR scalar float air.depth output with depth_qualifier
fragment_depth_discard.nil_fragment_pipeline: private raster_depth_only AOT program for depth/stencil-only pipeline descriptors
fragment_depth_discard.discard: MSL discard_fragment() and AIR air.discard_fragment() with helper-preserving software demotion on A5xx
fragment_depth_discard.lowering: Shared NIR pass remembers discarded lanes, predicates SSBO stores and all supported atomics, then terminates at a common exit; reads/private variables/derivatives continue. GLSL discard-loop escape lowering excludes demote. IR3 false dependencies keep explicit and implicit derivatives before the deferred KILL.
fragment_depth_discard.depth_testing: Late plane mode for no_earlyz, discard or replacement depth; RB_FS_OUTPUT_CNTL.FRAG_WRITES_Z and SP_FS_OUTPUT_CNTL.DEPTH_REGID are enabled only for actual depth exports. LRZ stays disabled.
fragment_depth_discard.wire: Shader32/JIT29; depthReg is an independent scalar output register, inactive zero. The following MSAA extension contains multisampleMask and depthTextureMask (the former reserved word). description2424/image41832/Draw2816.
fragment_depth_discard.air_float_comparisons: Both AIR readers share float32 scalar/vector1..4 FCmp lowering for all ordered/unordered predicates, with explicit NaN handling; no optional LLVM fast-math API required.

multisampling.texture_type: MTLTextureType2DMultisample and MTLTextureType2DMultisampleArray; private linear storage, one mip, rebased single-slice render/resolve views
multisampling.native_layout: fdl5 cpp = format bytes * samples; sample array varies fastest in X; pitch alignment grows by the sample count
multisampling.render_state: Matching samples across every attachment and PSO; A5xx RB, GRAS and TPL1 raster/destination sample fields; per-target color and depth/stencil pitches
multisampling.shader_msl: texture2d_ms<float,read>, read(coord,sample), get_num_samples/get_width/get_height in CS/VS/FS; no samplers
multisampling.compute_read: Bounded SSBO sample addressing with sRGB/BGRA/swizzle conversion
multisampling.graphics_read: Real IR3 ISAMM using the MSAA texture descriptor and guarded sample/coordinate operands
multisampling.color_resolve: Internal resolve_color MSL compute program, linear float4 average, one sRGB encoding; source view swizzle ignored for a framebuffer resolve
multisampling.resolve_validation: Same format/extents, single-sample destination; validate all attachment/destination aliases before clears; retain both textures through native fences
multisampling.wire: Shader31/JIT28, Texture48/Sampler28/Dispatch824/Draw2816, description2424/image41832; Apple outer resource/queue ABI and native limits264 unchanged
multisampling.multisample_mask: Dedicated immutable per-program eight-bit texture mask, separate from render sample count and fragment flags
unsupported: AIR multisample texture intrinsics until their signatures are verified

inputs: MSL uint sample_mask before depth/stencil tests
sample_shading.output: MSL uint sample_mask struct member and AIR scalar uint air.sample_mask; ignored with a single-sample attachment
sample_shading.variants: One public function ID and immutable owner; separate single-sample and MSAA IR3 code/constant/register allocations. Metal PSO and resource validation and native A540 submission select by render sample count.
sample_shading.hardware_mode: A5xx requires live HALF SampleID plus RB_RENDER_CONTROL1.SAMPLEMODE=3. HLSQ pixel/centroid/sample pairs, RB/GRAS enables, center-RHW and coverage export use compiler-owned registers.
sample_shading.position: At sample rate, hoist pixel-center XY and affine Z/reciprocal-W gradient correction before control flow in shared NIR lowering; center-qualified varyings keep pixel interpolators.
sample_shading.air_metadata_reference: steelbrain/metal2vulkan@720ef1ce9ae2a2068999a8675717418b9416283e engine/multisample.air.ll and engine/rt6_resolves.air.ll, recorded in gpu-msaa-primary-reference.json

depth_stencil_resolve.selection: Strict float32 comparisons select the first matching extremum; depth and stencil use identical selection even when no depth resolve destination is supplied. DepthResolvedSample requires a depth attachment.
depth_stencil_resolve.backend: Bounded native compute SSBO dispatches with immutable AOT IR3; raw uint D32 bit patterns are copied and compared through as_type<float>. No public image retyping or CPU resolve.
depth_stencil_resolve.stencil_packing: One work item owns a complete destination uint word; 1..3 trailing padding bytes are preserved and no inter-thread byte RMW occurs.
depth_stencil_resolve.validation: Same plane format/extent; 2x/4x source and 1x destination; check all attachment and resolve aliases before clears. Combined D32S8 planes may share non-overlapping backing.
depth_stencil_resolve.lifetime: Keep source, destination, depth dependency and parameter buffer alive through ordinary native queue/fence completion.
depth_stencil_resolve.wire: Existing Shader31/JIT28, description2424/image41832, Dispatch824 and native resource/queue ABI unchanged.

msl_bitcasts.scope: as_type<T> for float/int/uint 32-bit scalar/vector1..4 with matching lane count; GLSL overload checking rejects mismatched shapes or other scalar widths.
msl_bitcasts.lowering: uintBitsToFloat/intBitsToFloat, floatBitsToUint/floatBitsToInt and bit-preserving int/uint conversion; identity casts preserve their source.
unsupported: casts involving padded float3 and a different lane count

multisample_arrays.allocation: Private, single mip; page-aligned layer stride; total extent constrained by native resource limits.
multisample_arrays.compute_backend: Guarded SSBOs using native image and per-layer stride constants.
multisample_arrays.graphics_backend: Real A540 IR3 ISAMM with array flag, sampler2DMSArray lowering and native MSAA/array descriptors; no sampler required.
multisample_arrays.depth_stencil: D32 and D32S8 depth planes additionally support read/sample/compare; S8 remains render/resolve/blit-only. All are private. Combined arrays keep separate page-aligned depth/stencil layer strides.
multisample_arrays.views: Array ranges and same-sample 2D/2DMS single-slice views preserve original per-plane strides and backing.
multisample_arrays.render_resolve: Select source and destination slices, then existing color/D32/S8 GPU resolve kernels. Whole arrays and layered rendering remain rejected.
multisample_arrays.alias_checks: Include both D32S8 planes and sort actual intervals before recording multi-slice copies.
multisample_arrays.platform_scope: Own compiler/native profile: iOS18 SDK exposes texture type8 from iOS14; Apple MSL specification lists multisample arrays for macOS and does not list standard iOS language support. No Apple family conformance inferred.
unsupported: AIR multisample-array intrinsics without verified signatures
stencil shader reads and depth texture writes

depth_textures.read: raw float32; graphics TFMT5_32_FLOAT / guarded compute SSBO
depth_textures.sample_compare: hardware IR3 shadow instruction, sampler compare function0..7; compare before filtering
depth_textures.comparison_lod: Direct textureLod via the private EXT_texture_shadow_lod language bridge; NIR txl / IR3 saml.s preserves requested LOD and trilinear comparison weights without gradient reconstruction
depth_textures.storage_layout: Common linear color/D32/S8 layout; CPP-based aligned pitch, padded final mip, page-aligned chains and independent D32/S8 layer strides

gradient_sampling_single_evaluation.coordinate_gradient_layer_lod_operands: Evaluated once as helper parameters; mirror transforms and derivatives operate on values

ui_composition.composition_profile: premultiplied alpha, opacity, affine geometry, normalized crop and scissor; linear RGBA/BGRA8 UNorm/sRGB

native_graphics_texture_bindings.scope: AIR vertex/fragment metadata and native Metal graphics binding indices 0..15; at most eight enabled textures per specialized entry; compute and current MSL source binding profile remain at eight
native_graphics_texture_bindings.mapping: Preserve enabled logical indices 0..7; allocate higher enabled indices into remaining physical slots. Immutable eight-nibble textureBindings is zero for identity. Duplicate logical/physical bindings, index16 and more than eight enabled textures are rejected.
native_graphics_texture_bindings.wire: Program descriptions carry the mapping through compiler, archive, user encoder and kernel admission. Native IOGPU resources/queues and draw texture descriptor counts are unchanged.
native_graphics_texture_bindings.native_failure: round63 backboardd COREANIMATION abort: fixed_frag_lph_cpf TimgBdsoXfcn_Isrc uses original texture3 and noise texture9.
native_graphics_texture_bindings.numeric_fixes: Scalar constant i8/i16 AIR conversion inputs preserve signedness. LLVM scalar-backed constant splats preserve float16 vector width.

native_constant_windows.scope: Static readonly 16/32-bit fragment ranges; up to four independent, canonical nonoverlapping windows across logical buffers. Native GPU indirect constants retain exact integer bits and original bounded SSBO fallback.
native_constant_windows.validation: Actual buffer range, mapping, source16B alignment, destination/count64B, no SSBO writes; native physical attachment/read alias checks retained.
native_constant_windows.constant_layout: Original112word prefix;16words per window; one full vec4 valid flags after data; no overlap with immediates/driver constants.
native_constant_windows.guard_coalescing: Group independent static readonly 16/32-bit loads of one window within a basic block across pure SSA only. Preserve exact source bits, no crossing volatile/coherent/other memory, texture, barrier, output or control-flow boundaries; let Mesa merge identical uniform guards.
native_constant_windows.static_read_bounds: Readonly nonvolatile/noncoherent fragment SSBO constant32 offsets use size>=uint64(offset+relative+span) when end<=UINT32_MAX; odd half offsets or overflow are false. Dynamic/shared/store/atomic paths unchanged. Original scalar tail and guarded full-vector load retained.
native_constant_windows.full_window_specialization: Optional separately compiled base/MSAA variants specialize only native eligibility flags; actual GPU source bounds/alignment checked before selecting them, original bounded variants retained.
native_constant_windows.upload: Two immutable-owned shared-memory pieces, each at most 64 KiB; image 83704 bytes, description unchanged 2464 bytes.

ios18_display_intrinsics.precision: AIR float16/float32 scalar/vector1..4; transcendental half inputs use native f32 lowering and narrow once at the result
ios18_display_intrinsics.boolean_reductions: runtime air.any/air.all for bool vectors2..4, independent of function constants
ios18_display_intrinsics.extrema: Metal x op (y op z) ordering; numeric operand wins over a single NaN; AIR fast names or no-nans-fp-math=true omit NaN selection
ios18_display_intrinsics.sampling_offsets: constant int2 -8..7 for 2D/2DArray, implicit/explicit/gradient sampling through native texture offset instructions; zero offsets retain previous lowering
ios18_display_intrinsics.read_planar_offsets: zero only; distinct from sample texel offsets

unsigned_integer_images.scope: Compute read/write/query for 2D, array, cube and cube array mip views. Bit-exact uint reads/writes/swizzles; four-byte BGRA/RGBA raw views and IOSurface import. No integer filtering, render targets or multisampling.
unsigned_integer_images.air: uint4 texture intrinsics; half2/half4 word bitcasts; unorm4x8 half/float pack; bounded private int32/float32 arrays, at most 1024 bytes and eight array dimensions per entry.
unsigned_integer_images.branch_stack: A5xx compiler uses 64 reconvergence entries and SP register encodes pairs. Barrier-free shader limit32; shaders with workgroup barriers retain prior limit3 to preserve admission for full 1024-thread groups.
unsigned_integer_images.tests: IntegerTextures.air.ll authored examples; native uint-texture-test checks high bits, swizzles, raw views, IOSurface packing, dimensional mip addressing, all half bit patterns and private arrays.

air_direct_nir_runtime.policy: Try NIR for selected entries or an entire AIR library (up to 64 entries); resolve named constants per entry; commit the library only when all entries succeed. Discard partial images before the original GLSL fallback.
air_direct_nir_runtime.scope: Compute, vertex and fragment entries; reducible single-exit/nested loops with parallel PHIs; all existing compute system inputs; shared/dynamic threadgroup storage, relaxed int32 atomics and barriers; bounded private arrays and constant tables; packed integer reads and half word bitcasts; float/half 2D/array/cube/cube-array sampling, graphics reads/queries, compute float/uint image access; MRT/depth/sample mask/discard and existing AIR display math. General int64 scalar/vector arithmetic, casts, comparisons and guarded word-split memory; pointer select/PHIs over bounded buffers/shared/private storage, including null tests; multi-exit and irreducible CFG via Mesa unstructured-NIR structurization. Natural loops retain their compact path.
air_direct_nir_runtime.serialization: One Compiler.cpp mutex shared with GLSL compilation. NIR and LLVM handles stay private to the compiler dylib.
air_direct_nir_runtime.cache: Immutable LLVM decode templates for AIR >=32 KiB: four entries, 32 MiB retained source bytes, exact source equality, per-call specialization clones and context lifetime mutex. Direct capability-failure LRU: eight entries, 32 MiB source bytes, exact source/entry/constants/registry key; backend failures are retried. Process-local only; final existing shader caches are unchanged.
air_direct_nir_runtime.validation: Host compiler/interface/cache regressions, existing 54-entry finalized-NIR output differential, Compute/Welcome/eight Fluidity profile matrix, and independent integer/control-flow references for the remaining-features suite. Candidate-specific receipts live under build/air-nir-remaining-20261021. A540 hardware results remain separate.
air_direct_nir_runtime.fallback_limits: Unsupported Metal resource/intrinsic families, raw pointer-integer conversions, pointer ordering, unsupported aggregate/type shapes and atomic orders still use GLSL or report a checked error. Existing input/CFG/JIT machine-code and register limits remain enforced; expanded 64-bit division can reach those limits.
